experiment_data.hypothesis: KIVI baseline comparison: per-channel asymmetric KV cache quantization (KIVI method) on Qwen2.5-7B and Llama-3.1-8B at 2-bit and 4-bit. Addresses reviewer concern "no comparison with concurrent methods". Compare KIVI PPL vs our uniform 4-bit and constrained MCKP.
experiment_data.notes: KIVI baseline complete (2 models × 2 bits × 2 residual settings = 8 PPL numbers). Key: 4-bit barely affected by r128 (Δ<0.02), 2-bit r128 gives KIVI unfair advantage (Qwen +0.51, Llama +0.24). Use r0 numbers for fair comparison in paper. Artifacts: kivi_qwen25_7b.json, kivi_llama31_8b_r128.json, kivi_qwen25_7b_r0.json, kivi_llama31_8b_r0.json.
